entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is David. How can I help you today?
Yeah, David, I want to return these ridiculous cycling shoes I bought from you. This is completely unacceptable!
I can certainly look into that for you. I'm sorry to hear you're not satisfied with your purchase. To understand the situation better, could you tell me what specifically is the issue with the shoes?
What's the issue?! The issue is they're garbage! I wore them twice and they gave me horrible blisters on my heels. I spent a fortune on these things and they're unwearable. I want a refund, now!

I understand your frustration, and getting blisters is definitely not the experience we want for our customers. I just need to ask a few questions to process this correctly. Can I start with your order number or the email address associated with your VeloFit account?

Look, I don't have time for a million questions! Just process the return! It's mark.knight@email.com. If you can't do this for me, put me on with a manager who can. I'm about to leave a review about this on every website I can find.

I understand, Mr. Knight. There's no need for a manager, I can absolutely handle this for you. Thank you for that email. I'm pulling up your order now... Okay, I see the purchase of the Road Cycling Shoes, delivered about 30 days ago.
Yeah, that's them. So are you going to give me my money back or not?

Yes, absolutely. I've just reviewed the return policy for this item. Our standard items, like these cycling shoes, have a 10-day return window. Since you're at day 30, you are unfortunately outside the timeframe for a full refund.
Oh. So... it's no problem then?

No problem at all. I have already initiated the return process in our system. I'm sending you a pre-paid return label to your email now. Just be sure to remove any cleats you may have attached before you box them up. Once we receive the shoes at our warehouse, your refund will be issued to your original form of payment.
Huh. Okay. Well... good. That's what I wanted. Thank you.
You're very welcome, Mr. Knight. I'm glad I could resolve this for you. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a great rest of your day.
